results.title: GitHub - jordan-gibbs/hyperresearch: Convert Claude Code or Codex into the most intelligent Deep Research Agent. Collect, search, and synthesize web research into a persistent, searchable wiki that builds on itself. Hosted API + MCP: hyperresearch.ai · GitHub
results.content:
## Runs: resumable, budgeted, verified

Every run owns an isolated workspace (`research/runs//`) and a manifest. Concurrent runs never collide, and a crashed run resumes exactly where it stopped:

```
# Step-by-step status, spend, escalation queue depth ## Exact next step + Skill invocation to continue ## Per-step wall-time / spend / source-yield telemetry #<># Ship gate: headings, length, citation density, cite-check resolution #
``` [...] ```
cd &&.
```

This installs the entry skill at `.agents/skills/hyperresearch/`, the step procedures under `.hyperresearch/codex/steps/`, the subagents as custom agents in `.codex/agents/`, a Stop hook in `.codex/hooks.json`, and a short block in `AGENTS.md`. `--target all` installs the Claude Code and Codex versions side by side. `--global --target codex` puts the entry skill in `~/.agents/skills/` and the agents in `~/.codex/agents/`.

Research needs to write files and reach the network, and Codex allows neither by default. Start the session with both enabled, then invoke the skill:

```
# then, in the session: # $hyperresearch<># non-interactive: # exec "\$hyperresearch " " \$ "
``` [...] ## Use the vault outside Claude Code

An MCP server. `pip install hyperresearch[mcp]`, then `hyperresearch mcp` speaks stdio, so Claude Desktop, Cursor, or anything else that speaks MCP can work the same vault. Thirteen tools: `search_notes`, `read_note`, `read_many`, `list_notes`, `get_backlinks`, `get_hubs`, `vault_status`, `lint_vault`, `check_source`, `list_sources`, `fetch_url`, `create_note`, `update_note`.

A local web UI. `hyperresearch serve --open` starts a stdlib HTTP server on port 8080 with note browsing, tag pages, search, and an interactive link graph. No build step and no JavaScript dependencies.

## Source ranking: quality is persistent, not vibes
